name: web-extract-mcp
description: Parse local HTML/HTM files into structured Markdown, tables (CSV/XLSX), and link JSON, fully offline. No network fetching.
long_description: Local-first HTML extraction: table/element structure to Markdown, tables to CSV or Excel, links to JSON with relative-to-absolute resolution, batch directory mode. Python stdlib HTMLParser + openpyxl, runs entirely on the user's machine, never fetches URLs.
